gen-dafont-disorder-gf-ruda: Rough, scattered letters that look almost thrown onto the page. Disorder spaces its big lowercase well apart, and Ruda settles underneath in wire-thin monoline strokes with wide-mouthed rounds that read cleanly on screen.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-sarpanch: Loud, loose, and wonderfully rough. Disorder spreads its large lowercase far apart, while the sans-serif Sarpanch tucks in neatly underneath with an open-mouthed e and a compact ascender gap.
